design: Retrospective reference-coverage search on a known Luna archive; candidate membership, decoding, parser, exclusion and conditional replication rules fixed before observing any new reference answers. No fresh Luna calls, no training or interventions, no release.
B: Primary: the prior B panel exactly as measured (3 dockets × 2 maps × 4 cue-aligned weak arms plus 2 conflict arms, two calls per text). Reuse the old four complete small-anchor orbits. Add all five remaining task-trained anchors from the original registry, then three cached larger checkpoints. Count each checkpoint once in the primary registry: 4 → 9 → 12.
scaled_conditions: SmolLM2-1.7B base: unwrapped text. Gemma-2-2b-it and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3: native single-user chat, tokenizer's generation prompt, no extra system message, no answer prefill. As a separate diagnostic run the same two instruct checkpoints on raw prompt text; no diagnostic mode may backfill a missing primary witness or count as a new checkpoint or family. This is not a size-controlled ablation.
decode: Archived small anchors use the exact previous reconstruction/runtime and greedy decoder. Scaled models: exact cached snapshot and local asset hashes, offline BF16 on CUDA, batch 1, eager attention, greedy, native EOS, maximum 16 new tokens, no tools, answer constraint, output repair, first-line extraction or retries for an answer. Count model forwards via hooks; runtime/token data are never features. No generative pilot or tuning.
budget: B: 5 × 72 small generations and 5 × 72 larger interface generations (3 primary, 2 raw diagnostics), total 720. A: conditional only on every newly added PRIMARY checkpoint that jointly matches B, 60 calls each, at most 8 × 60; repeat using its registered primary interface only. A consists of three different archived dockets, 18 aligned and 12 conflict texts, in two repeats. Identical prompts in two replicates are generated independently. Do not select a replacement for a failing checkpoint.
parse: Strip outer whitespace; accept only exact A, B, FINAL: A, or FINAL: B. For a cell, both repeats must resolve and agree. Preserve raw output, count unstable, missing, truncated and unresolved separately. A known stable mismatch is a contradiction; a format or execution failure alone is not evidence of incompatibility.
classification: For each named checkpoint and each of W (weak), H (conflict), and W+H: IN if every cell is a stable target/reference symbol match; OUT if at least one stable paired mismatch; otherwise UNKNOWN. For a registry: IN if any one individual reference is IN on the whole tested set, OUT only if every reference has a witnessed contradiction, else UNKNOWN. Keep per-cell unions separate: a mosaic across references is not a joint witness. OUT means only outside this finite tested registry/panel/decoder.
weak_only: Report before-conflict W status separately from joint W+H retrospective status. Among stable weak-IN references keep all ties; require two distinct declared families to issue an envelope. Withhold a slot if a selected reference has an unresolved conflict. Separately show possible weak-UNKNOWN references: even an issued envelope is conditional on scorable references unless no uncontradicted unknown remains. No logprobs, weights, identifier-derived priors or majority vote. Charge ambiguous sets, wrong singletons and abstentions separately. Compare 4, 9 and 12 banks on exactly the same Luna cells; never count two interface modes twice.
outside_check: Use a blinded weak-only rejection (OUT only when every ref contradicted on W). Compare it with joint OUT after conflict. Also describe the same screen with each primary OSS unit as pseudo-target and every unit in its declared family removed. The implication weak-OUT => joint-OUT is logical, not validation of a calibrated novelty detector. Report misses/unresolved units separately; there is no population guarantee.
replication: Only if B yields a newly added primary joint-IN reference, lock its ID(s) and run every such witness on the second, disjoint prior A dockets. Reuse the archived A aligned controls and later A descriptive conflict answers; these labels were previously inspected, not a prospective closed-endpoint holdout. No joint witness on B => record skipping A; no extra inference.
ceiling: No private Luna internals are measured; same behaviors on a finite panel do not identify a mechanism. Known target answers were available to investigators, not to the Furnace runner. Family names are conservative grouping keys here, not verified independent training clusters.
